ext_description.message: Send web pages to your Schreibwerkstatt as a research find or a citable source.

notify_saved_research.message: Filed as a research find in “$1”.

notify_saved_source.message: Filed as a source in your library.

notify_saved_both.message: Filed as a find and as a source in “$1”.

notify_undo_too_late_message.message: The quote is already on its way.

notify_setup_needed_message.message: Enter the server address and token first.

notify_no_book_message.message: Pick a default book for quotes in the settings.

notify_no_selection_message.message: Select the text you want to quote first.

notify_quote_too_long_message.message: The limit is $1 characters, the selection had $2.

err_not_logged_in.message: The device token is no longer valid — it has expired or been revoked. Create a new one in the web app and enter it here.

err_device_scope_forbidden.message: This token is not allowed to do that. It was issued as a capture token (kind: 'capture') and can only reach the paths cleared for capturing. Get a suitable one in the web app under Settings › Devices.

err_demo_token_fixed.message: This demo token is fixed and cannot be revoked through the interface.

err_no_book_access.message: You have no access to this book — or it does not exist. The server deliberately does not distinguish the two.

err_insufficient_role.message: You may only read this book (role: $1). Capturing needs $2 rights — the book's owner grants those.

err_invalid_id.message: The book reference is missing or invalid.

err_bookid_req.message: This needs a book. Please pick one.

err_invalid_value.message: The server does not accept this value for “$1”. Allowed: $2.

err_invalid_url.message: The server cannot process this address. It must start with http:// or https://.

err_empty.message: A research find needs at least a title, some text or a URL.

err_source_identity_req.message: A source needs at least a title or one person.

err_citekey_taken.message: The citation key “$1” is already taken in your library.

err_item_not_found.message: The research find this attachment belongs to does not exist on the server.

err_no_image.message: The server saw no image — the attachment was empty or had the wrong type.

err_image_invalid.message: The server could not read this image.

err_no_doc.message: The server saw no PDF — the attachment was empty or had the wrong type.

err_doc_too_large.message: The PDF is larger than the 25 MB allowed.

err_doc_not_pdf.message: This file is not a PDF.

err_doc_unreadable.message: The server could not read this PDF — it is encrypted or damaged.

err_not_source_owner.message: This source belongs to another account. Only whoever holds it in their library may change it.

err_url_req.message: This query is missing the address.

err_lookup_param_required.message: The lookup needs either a DOI or an ISBN.

err_lookup_param_ambiguous.message: Please give either a DOI or an ISBN, not both.

err_lookup_not_found.message: The registry does not know this identifier. The fields stay as they are.

err_lookup_unavailable.message: The registry (Crossref or OpenLibrary) is currently unreachable.

err_no_server_configured.message: No server address has been entered yet.

err_no_token_configured.message: No device token has been entered yet.

err_client_validation_failed.message: The data is incomplete — nothing was sent.

err_client_image_too_large.message: The screenshot is larger than the 12 MB allowed.

err_client_doc_too_large.message: The PDF is larger than the 25 MB allowed — nothing was sent.

err_client_payload_too_large.message: This entry is too large for a single call.

err_harvest_failed.message: This page cannot be read. On Chrome's own pages and in the Web Store that is normal.

err_invalid_server_url.message: This server address cannot be used.

err_unmapped_code.message: The server reported an error this version of the extension does not know (HTTP $2): $1

err_payload_too_large.message: The server aborted the transfer because it was too large. Limits: image 12 MB, PDF 25 MB.

err_unsupported_media_type.message: The server does not accept this file type.

err_rate_limited.message: Too many requests. It will be retried later.

err_server_error.message: The server reported an error. It will be retried later.

err_network.message: No connection to the server. The item is waiting in the queue.

err_status_404.message: Your server does not have this endpoint.

err_status_timeout.message: The server did not answer in time.

validation_title_too_long.message: The title may be at most $1 characters, it currently has $2.

validation_body_too_long.message: The text may be at most $1 characters, it currently has $2.

validation_research_empty.message: Title, text or URL – at least one must be filled in.

validation_csl_type_invalid.message: Please pick a valid source type.

validation_source_identity.message: A source needs at least a title or one person.

validation_url_scheme.message: The URL must start with http:// or https://.

validation_image_too_large.message: The image may be at most $1 MB, it is $2 MB.

validation_doc_too_large.message: The PDF may be at most $1 MB, it is $2 MB.

popup_setup_needed.message: Please enter the server address and token in the settings first.

popup_book_viewer_hint.message: Books you can only read are greyed out.

popup_truncated_hint.message: Shortened to $1 characters (original: $2), cut at a sentence boundary.

popup_clamp_hint.message: The server shortens silently when saving — these fields will go out shortened: $1

popup_saved_source_existed.message: The source was already in your library and was only linked to the book.

popup_saved_research_existed.message: This research find already existed — the server recognised the double click.

popup_lookup_recommended.message: This page carries a DOI – fetch the canonical metadata.

popup_lookup_applied.message: Took over $1 field(s) from the database.

popup_pdf_cross_origin.message: The PDF lives on $1 – no permission for that host.

popup_pdf_failed.message: The PDF could not be loaded ($1).

popup_duplicate_in_book.message: This source is already in this book.

popup_duplicate_in_library.message: This source is already in your library, but not in this book.

popup_duplicate_research.message: This book already holds $1 entry/entries for this page.

popup_duplicate_incomplete_limit.message: Only the $1 most recently changed entries were checked – older duplicates cannot be ruled out.

popup_duplicate_incomplete_fts.message: The server's search stops after $1 hits – “nothing found” does not mean “not there”.

popup_duplicate_scope_missing.message: Duplicate check unavailable: the device token lacks read permission (DEVICE_SCOPE_FORBIDDEN).

popup_queued.message: Did not get through – waiting in the queue. $1

provenance_site.message: Wiki page detected – title, revision date and permalink from the page structure

provenance_fallback.message: No metadata found – everything guessed, please check

options_lead.message: Capture web pages as a research find or as a citable source.

options_connection_lead.message: Enter the address of your Schreibwerkstatt and create a token in the web app under Settings → Devices.

options_server_url_invalid.message: That is not a valid http(s) address.

options_server_url_insecure.message: Without TLS the token travels in the clear. http is therefore limited to localhost and 127.0.0.1 — use https for anything else.

options_token_hint.message: Stored locally only (chrome.storage.local), never synced through your Google account.

options_token_format.message: A token starting with swd_ is expected.

options_permission_missing.message: Access to $1 is still missing – nothing can be sent without it.

options_books_lead.message: The book that quotes from the context menu go to without asking.

options_undo_delay_hint.message: How long the extension waits before actually sending a quote. 0 = send immediately.

options_harvest_text.message: Prefill the main text of the page

options_capabilities_lead.message: Two endpoints are not rolled out everywhere yet. The extension detects them automatically and otherwise falls back to the longer path.

options_cap_research_scope_missing.message: GET /research exists, but this device token may not read (DEVICE_SCOPE_FORBIDDEN). The duplicate check stays off.

options_cap_never_probed.message: Not checked yet – the connection test does it automatically.

options_queue_lead.message: Whatever did not get through while offline or during server errors waits here. Nothing is discarded on its own.

options_queue_discard_confirm.message: Discard “$1” for good? The entry will be lost.

notice_attachment_lost.message: The screenshot or PDF was lost when the browser restarted — the attachment is missing and has to be added again in the web app.

notice_citekey_dropped.message: The citation key “$1” was already taken — the server assigned one of its own.

options_privacy_1.message: Only what you explicitly capture: title, text, URL and bibliographic data of the page currently open.

options_privacy_2.message: Only to the host entered above. No analytics, no CDN, no external fonts, no third party.

options_privacy_3.message: No history, no background crawling, no automatic capture. No access to pages where you do not trigger the extension.

options_privacy_4.message: The token lives in chrome.storage.local and is not synced.
